description: This file defines a React functional component 'FeaturesUsageCharts' that renders two bar charts for visualizing the most and least used features. It imports React, chart components from 'recharts', and custom UI components like Card and Skeleton. The component uses theme context for styling and processes input props to normalize data before rendering charts or placeholders.

methods.name: FeaturesUsageCharts
methods.description: React functional component that renders two bar charts side-by-side for most and least used features, with loading and empty states.
